text: Twelve-year-old Tinja trains as a gymnast for a mother who presents a perfect family on her blog and [snaps the neck of a crow that flies into the house|wrong|harming the natural world]. In the woods Tinja [takes the crow's orphaned egg home|trigger|bringing something home] and hides it from her family as it grows enormous and hatches a bird-like creature she names Alli. Alli [acts on every feeling Tinja hides|rules|it gets inside you], and with each molt [it looks more like her|threat|impostors and doubles].
